literal: Day yimao: Prince of Dongping Lue was made Left Grand Master of Splendid Carriages and Bearer of the Triple Staff.
idiomatic: On yimao day Lue, prince of Dongping, was made left grand master of splendid carriages and bearer of the triple staff.

literal: Seventh month of autumn, day bingwu: Du Luozhou sent his separate commander Cao Hezhen to raid You Province.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingwu day, Du Luozhou sent his separate commander Cao Hezhen to raid You Province.

literal: Chang Jing of the mobile office sent Commander Yu Rong to intercept them at Su Garden, [14] greatly defeated them, beheaded Hezhen, and took more than thirty heads and more than twenty thousand oxen and donkeys.
idiomatic: Chang Jing of the mobile office sent Commander Yu Rong to intercept them at Su Garden, [14] greatly defeated them, beheaded Hezhen, and took more than thirty heads and more than twenty thousand oxen and donkeys.

literal: Day wushen: Heng Province fell; Yuan Zuan of the mobile office fled to Ji Province.
idiomatic: On wushen day Heng Province fell; Yuan Zuan of the mobile office fled to Ji Province.

literal: Day jiazi: Xiao Yan's generals Yuan Shu, Zhan Sengzhen, and others raided Shouchun.
idiomatic: On jiazi day Xiao Yan's generals Yuan Shu, Zhan Sengzhen, and others raided Shouchun.

literal: Eighth month, day bingzi: Yuan Yan, state-founding Duke of Guangchuan, was advanced to Prince of Changshan.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingzi day, Yuan Yan, state-founding duke of Guangchuan, was advanced to prince of Changshan.

literal: [15] Prince of Huaiyang Yu, Grand General Who Conquers on Horseback and Eastern Route Mobile Office commander, was made Bearer of the Triple Staff.
idiomatic: [15] Yu, prince of Huaiyang, grand general who conquers on horseback and eastern route mobile office commander, was made bearer of the triple staff.

literal: Day wuyin: the emperor visited the Southern Stone Grotto Temple and returned to the palace the same day.
idiomatic: On wuyin day the emperor visited the Southern Stone Grotto Temple and returned to the palace the same day.

literal: Day wuzi: Ziyou, scattered cavalier attendant, censor-in-chief, and state-founding Duke of Wucheng, was advanced to Prince of Changle.
idiomatic: On wuzi day Ziyou, scattered cavalier attendant, censor-in-chief, and state-founding duke of Wucheng, was advanced to prince of Changle.

literal: Commander Yi Longsheng attacked Ba, was defeated, and died in battle.
idiomatic: Commander Yi Longsheng attacked Ba, was defeated, and died in battle.

literal: Day guisi: the bandit chief Yuan Hongye beheaded Xianyu Xiuli and offered surrender; he was killed by the bandit faction of Ge Rong.
idiomatic: On guisi day the bandit chief Yuan Hongye beheaded Xianyu Xiuli and offered surrender; he was killed by the bandit faction of Ge Rong.

literal: Commander Erzhu Rong at Si Province seized Inspector Wei Qingbin and had his younger uncle Yusheng administer the province.
idiomatic: Commander Erzhu Rong at Si Province seized Inspector Wei Qingbin and had his younger uncle Yusheng administer the province.

literal: Ninth month, day xinhai: Ge Rong defeated Commander Prince of Guangyang Yuan and Prince of Zhangwu Rong at Bolu White Oxen Camp; Rong died in the battle line.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinhai day, Ge Rong defeated Yuan, commander and prince of Guangyang, and Rong, prince of Zhangwu, at Bolu White Oxen Camp; Rong died in the battle line.

literal: Rong styled himself Son of Heaven, state name Qi, era name Guang'an.
idiomatic: Rong styled himself Son of Heaven, state name Qi, era name Guang'an.

literal: Day jiashen: Chang Jing again defeated Luozhou, beheaded his Prince of Wuchuan Hebawenxing and separate commander Houmochen Sheng, and captured alive four hundred men and women and more than five thousand oxen and donkeys.
idiomatic: On jiashen day Chang Jing again defeated Luozhou, beheaded his Prince of Wuchuan Hebawenxing and separate commander Houmochen Sheng, and captured alive four hundred men and women and more than five thousand oxen and donkeys.

literal: Jiudexing took Ping Province and killed Inspector Wang Mainu.
idiomatic: Jiudexing took Ping Province and killed Inspector Wang Mainu.

literal: That month: Moqi Tiansheng offered surrender; Xiao Baoyu sent Left Assistant of the Mobile Office Cui Shihe to enter and hold Qin Province.
idiomatic: That month Moqi Tiansheng offered surrender; Baoyu sent Cui Shihe, left assistant of the mobile office, to enter and hold Qin Province.

literal: Tiansheng rebelled again, sent Shihe to Hu Chen, and killed him.
idiomatic: Tiansheng rebelled again, sent Shihe to Hu Chen, and killed him.

literal: Eleventh month of winter, day wuxu: Du Luozhou took You Province, seized Inspector Wang Yannian and Chang Jing of the mobile office.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on wuxu day, Du Luozhou took You Province, seized Wang Yannian, inspector, and Chang Jing of the mobile office.

literal: Day bingwu: field tax in the capital was levied at five sheng per mu;
idiomatic: On bingwu day field tax in the capital was levied at five sheng per mu;

literal: those borrowing public fields paid one dou per mu.
idiomatic: those borrowing public fields paid one dou per mu.

literal: [16] Intercalary month: those entering or leaving the market paid one coin each; shops and lodgings were graded in five classes.
idiomatic: [16] In the intercalary month those entering or leaving the market paid one coin each; shops and lodgings were graded in five classes.

literal: The people of Pingyuan in Qi Province, Liu Shu and Liu Cangsheng, gathered a crowd and rebelled; provincial troops routed them; Liu Shu fled to Xiao Yan.
idiomatic: The people of Pingyuan in Qi Province, Liu Shu and Liu Cangsheng, gathered a crowd and rebelled; provincial troops routed them; Liu Shu fled to Xiao Yan.

literal: Yan's general Yuan Shu pressed Shouchun; [17] Inspector Li Xian was overcome and surrendered the city.
idiomatic: Yan's general Yuan Shu pressed Shouchun; [17] Li Xian, inspector, was overcome and surrendered the city.

literal: At first hostages of provinces, commanderies, counties, chief clerks, administrators, and garrison chiefs and deputies had been detained in the capital.
idiomatic: At first hostages of provinces, commanderies, counties, chief clerks, administrators, and garrison chiefs and deputies had been detained in the capital.

literal: Yan again sent generals to press Xinye; an edict ordered Commander Wei Chengzu to attack them.
idiomatic: Yan again sent generals to press Xinye; an edict ordered Wei Chengzu, commander, to attack them.

literal: An edict stated: "Lately the old capital fell and the central plain was lost in disorder; imperial clan sons and daughters registered within the seven temples who were detained and shamed by mixed households and illicit gates may all sever those ties."
idiomatic: An edict stated: "Lately the old capital fell and the central plain was lost in disorder; imperial clan sons and daughters registered within the seven temples who were detained and shamed by mixed households and illicit gates may all sever those ties."

literal: Third year, spring, first month, day jiaxu: Huangfu Du, Duke of Minister of Works, was made Minister over the Masses; Bearer of the Triple Staff Xiao Baoyu was made Minister of Works; General of Chariots and Cavalry and Prince of Beihai Yan was made Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry and Bearer of the Triple Staff.
idiomatic: In the third year, spring, first month, on jiaxu day, Huangfu Du, duke of minister of works, was made minister over the masses; Baoyu, bearer of the triple staff, was made minister of works; Yan, general of chariots and cavalry and prince of Beihai, was made grand general of chariots and cavalry and bearer of the triple staff.

literal: The people of Xuzhou, Ren Daoling, gathered a crowd and rebelled, seized and held Xiaocheng in revolt.
idiomatic: The people of Xuzhou, Ren Daoling, gathered a crowd and rebelled, seized and held Xiaocheng in revolt.

literal: Provincial troops suppressed and pacified them.
idiomatic: Provincial troops suppressed and pacified them.

literal: Day xinsi: Ge Rong took Yin Province; Inspector Cui Kai held firm to integrity and died; he then besieged Ji Province from the east.
idiomatic: On xinsi day Ge Rong took Yin Province; Cui Kai, inspector, held firm to integrity and died; he then besieged Ji Province from the east.

literal: Day jiashen: an edict tightened the system for casting coin.
idiomatic: On jiashen day an edict tightened the system for casting coin.

literal: Xiao Baoyu and Yuan Hengzhi were greatly defeated at Jing Province; Grand Commander of Great Long, Prince of Nanping Zhongtong, and Commander of Little Long Gao Yu both withdrew in succession; Pan Yiyuan, inspector of East Qin, surrendered Qian city to the bandits.
idiomatic: Baoyu and Hengzhi were greatly defeated at Jing Province; Zhongtong, grand commander of great Long and prince of Nanping, and Gao Yu, commander of little Long, both withdrew in succession; Pan Yiyuan, inspector of East Qin, surrendered Qian city to the bandits.

literal: The barbarian bandits of Gaoping pressed Qi Province; the townspeople seized Inspector Wei Langen and joined the city to them.
idiomatic: The barbarian bandits of Gaoping pressed Qi Province; the townspeople seized Wei Langen, inspector, and joined the city to them.

literal: Inspector Bi Zuhui and Chang Shen of the mobile office both fled; Zuhui died in the battle line.
idiomatic: Zuhui, inspector, and Shen, mobile office director, both fled; Zuhui died in the battle line.

literal: Prince of Beihai Yan likewise was defeated and fled.
idiomatic: Yan, prince of Beihai, likewise was defeated and fled.

literal: The bandit chief Hu Yinzu held North Hua Province in response.
idiomatic: The bandit chief Hu Yinzu held North Hua Province in response.

literal: The bandit chief Chigan Qilin entered and held Bin Province.
idiomatic: The bandit chief Chigan Qilin entered and held Bin Province.

literal: [18] A partial amnesty for Guanxi and Zhengping, Pingyang, and Jianxing.
idiomatic: [18] A partial amnesty was proclaimed for Guanxi and Zhengping, Pingyang, and Jianxing.

literal: Day wuzi: Huangfu Du, Minister of Works, was made Grand Commandant.
idiomatic: On wuzi day Huangfu Du, minister of works, was made grand commandant.

literal: Day jichou: because the four quarters were not pacified, an edict placed within and without on alert; the emperor was about to campaign in person.
idiomatic: On jichou day because the four quarters were not pacified, an edict placed within and without on alert; the emperor was about to campaign in person.

literal: Day xinmao: Xiao Yan's general Zhan Sengzhen besieged East Yi Province; [19] an edict made Yuan Wei, scattered cavalier attendant, commander to attack them.
idiomatic: On xinmao day Zhan Sengzhen, Xiao Yan's general, besieged East Yi Province; [19] an edict made Yuan Wei, scattered cavalier attendant, commander to attack them.

literal: That month: Yan again sent generals Peng Qun, Wang Bian, and others with tens of thousands to press Langye; an edict ordered Qing and South Qing provinces to attack them.
idiomatic: That month Yan again sent generals Peng Qun, Wang Bian, and others with tens of thousands to press Langye; an edict ordered Qing and South Qing provinces to attack them.

literal: Second month, day dingyou, an edict stated: "Guan and Long have suffered raider calamity; Yan and Zhao are overrun by bandit rebels; the common people drift on the waves and farming has no livelihood. Added transport and corvée labor are already heavy; provincial granaries should not hang empty—unless a standard is opened for delivering grain as reward, how can the trouble of canal transport be stilled?
idiomatic: In the second month, on dingyou day, an edict stated: "Guan and Long have suffered raider calamity; Yan and Zhao are overrun by bandit rebels; the common people drift on the waves and farming has no livelihood. Added transport and corvée labor are already heavy; provincial granaries should not hang empty—unless a standard is opened for delivering grain as reward, how can the trouble of canal transport be stilled?

literal: All who can deliver grain into the four provinces of Ying, Ding, Qi, and Yong receive one grade of office for every two hundred hu by official measure;
idiomatic: All who can deliver grain into the four provinces of Ying, Ding, Qi, and Yong receive one grade of office for every two hundred hu by official measure;

literal: into the two Hua provinces, one grade for five hundred shi.
idiomatic: into the two Hua provinces, one grade for five hundred shi.

literal: There is no limit on amount; when the grain is delivered, office is granted."
idiomatic: There is no limit on amount; when the grain is delivered, office is granted."

literal: The barbarian bandits held Tong Pass.
idiomatic: The barbarian bandits held Tong Pass.

literal: Day dingwei: the deceased Prince of Dongping Kuang's rank was posthumously restored and changed to Prince of Jinan.
idiomatic: On dingwei day the deceased Kuang's rank was posthumously restored and changed to prince of Jinan.

literal: Day gengshen: the people of Dong commandery, Zhao Xiande, rebelled, killed Administrator Pei Yan, styled himself commander, installed his brother's son as administrator; an edict ordered Commander Li Shuren to attack them.
idiomatic: On gengshen day the people of Dong commandery, Zhao Xiande, rebelled, killed Pei Yan, administrator, styled himself commander, installed his brother's son as administrator; an edict ordered Li Shuren, commander, to attack them.

literal: That month: Xiao Yan's general Cheng Jingjun raided Pengcheng; an edict made Yuanwai Changshi Cui Xiaofen mobile office commander to lead generals and drive them off.
idiomatic: That month Cheng Jingjun, Xiao Yan's general, raided Pengcheng; an edict made Cui Xiaofen, yuanwai changshi, mobile office commander to lead generals and drive them off.

literal: Third month, day jiazi: an edict ordered a western campaign; within and without were placed on alert.
idiomatic: In the third month, on jiazi day, an edict ordered a western campaign; within and without were placed on alert.

literal: The barbarian bandits fled; Tong Pass was recovered.
idiomatic: The barbarian bandits fled; Tong Pass was recovered.

literal: Day wuchen: an edict ordered the return of the carriage for a northern campaign; an edict made Yuan Ziyou, grand master of splendid carriages with golden seal and purple cord, grand commander to attack Ge Rong.
idiomatic: On wuchen day an edict ordered the return of the carriage for a northern campaign; an edict made Yuan Ziyou, grand master of splendid carriages with golden seal and purple cord, grand commander to attack Ge Rong.

literal: Day xinwei: the people of Guangchuan in Qi Province, Liu Jun, seized Qinghe Administrator Shao Huai, gathered a crowd and rebelled, and styled himself Grand Mobile Office.
idiomatic: On xinwei day the people of Guangchuan in Qi Province, Liu Jun, seized Shao Huai, Qinghe administrator, gathered a crowd and rebelled, and styled himself grand mobile office.

literal: The people of Qinghe, Fang Xu, styled himself grand commander [20] and camped at Changguo city.
idiomatic: The people of Qinghe, Fang Xu, styled himself grand commander [20] and camped at Changguo city.

literal: Fourth month of summer: separate commander Yuan Binzhi attacked Dong commandery and beheaded Xiande.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer separate commander Yuan Binzhi attacked Dong commandery and beheaded Xiande.

literal: Day jiyou: the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On jiyou day the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Sixth month: the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the sixth month the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.

literal: That month: an edict ordered Commander Li Shuren to attack Liu Jun and pacify them.
idiomatic: That month an edict ordered Li Shuren, commander, to attack Liu Jun and pacify them.

literal: Seventh month of autumn: the people of Chen commandery, Liu Huo and Zheng Bian, rebelled at Xihua, styled their era Tian shou; provincial troops suppressed and pacified them.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn the people of Chen commandery, Liu Huo and Zheng Bian, rebelled at Xihua, styled their era Tian shou; provincial troops suppressed and pacified them.

literal: Inspector of Xiang Province and Prince of Anle Jian held the province in rebellion.
idiomatic: Jian, inspector of Xiang Province and prince of Anle, held the province in rebellion.

literal: Day jichou: a general amnesty throughout the realm.
idiomatic: On jichou day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

literal: That month: Liu Shao, inspector of Qing Province and Prince of Pengcheng, and Hu Ping, inspector of South Qing, sent generals to behead the head of Xiao Yan's general Peng Qun and capture more than two thousand.
idiomatic: That month Liu Shao, inspector of Qing Province and prince of Pengcheng, and Hu Ping, inspector of South Qing, sent generals to behead the head of Peng Qun, Xiao Yan's general, and capture more than two thousand.

literal: Eighth month: commanders Yuan Ziyou, Li Gui, and Pei Yan attacked Ye.
idiomatic: In the eighth month commanders Yuan Ziyou, Li Gui, and Pei Yan attacked Ye.

literal: Day dingwei: Jian was beheaded; Xiang Province was pacified.
idiomatic: On dingwei day Jian was beheaded; Xiang Province was pacified.

literal: They were then ordered to attack Ge Rong.
idiomatic: They were then ordered to attack Ge Rong.

literal: Ninth month, day xinmao, [21] Yuan Qinghe, inspector of East Yi Province, rebelled with the south of the city.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinmao day, [21] Yuan Qinghe, inspector of East Yi Province, rebelled with the south of the city.

literal: Day wuzi: the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On wuzi day the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.

literal: The townspeople of Qin Province killed Moqi Niansheng and acted as provincial governor themselves.
idiomatic: The townspeople of Qin Province killed Moqi Niansheng and acted as provincial governor themselves.

literal: The townspeople of South Qin Province, Xin Chen, acted as provincial governor themselves and sent envoys to confess guilt.
idiomatic: The townspeople of South Qin Province, Xin Chen, acted as provincial governor themselves and sent envoys to confess guilt.

literal: Tenth month of winter, day wushen: a partial amnesty west of Hengnong, Hebei, Zhengping, Pingyang, Shao commandery, and the provinces of Guanxi.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wushen day, a partial amnesty was proclaimed west of Hengnong, Hebei, Zhengping, Pingyang, Shao commandery, and the provinces of Guanxi.

literal: Day xinhai: Erzhu Rong, general of the guard and grand commander who campaigns against barbarians, was made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Bearer of the Triple Staff.
idiomatic: On xinhai day Rong, general of the guard and grand commander who campaigns against barbarians, was made general of chariots and cavalry and bearer of the triple staff.

literal: Day jiayin: Xiao Baoyu, inspector of Yong Province, held the province in rebellion, styled his state Qi, era name Longxu.
idiomatic: On jiayin day Baoyu, inspector of Yong Province, held the province in rebellion, styled his state Qi, era name Longxu.

literal: An edict ordered Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Changsun Zhi to attack them.
idiomatic: An edict ordered Changsun Zhi, right vice director of the Masters of Writing, to attack them.

literal: Eleventh month, day jichou: Ge Rong took Ji Province, seized Inspector Yuan Fu, drove out the residents, and six or seven in ten froze to death.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jichou day, Ge Rong took Ji Province, seized Yuan Fu, inspector, drove out the residents, and six or seven in ten froze to death.

literal: Twelfth month, day wushen: commanders Yuan Ziyou and Pei Yan fought Ge Rong, were defeated at the bend of the Zhang River northeast of Yangping, and both died in battle.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wushen day, commanders Yuan Ziyou and Pei Yan fought Ge Rong, were defeated at the bend of the Zhang River northeast of Yangping, and both died in battle.

literal: That month: Du Can was killed by Luo Chao; Chao sent envoys to confess guilt.
idiomatic: That month Du Can was killed by Luo Chao; Chao sent envoys to confess guilt.

literal: First year of Wutai, spring, first month, day guihai: Prince of Beihai Yan was made Grand General Who Conquers on Horseback, Opener of the Office, Bearer of the Triple Staff, and Inspector of Xiang Province.
idiomatic: In the first year of Wutai, spring, first month, on guihai day, Yan, prince of Beihai, was made grand general who conquers on horseback, opener of the office, bearer of the triple staff, and inspector of Xiang Province.

literal: Day yichou: Ding Province was taken by Du Luozhou; Inspector Yang Jin was seized.
idiomatic: On yichou day Ding Province was taken by Du Luozhou; Yang Jin, inspector, was seized.

literal: Yuan Ning, inspector of Ying Province, surrendered the city to Luozhou.
idiomatic: Yuan Ning, inspector of Ying Province, surrendered the city to Luozhou.

literal: An imperial daughter was born; it was secretly said to be a prince.
idiomatic: An imperial daughter was born; it was secretly said to be a prince.

literal: Day bingyin: a general amnesty; the era name was changed.
idiomatic: On bingyin day a general amnesty was proclaimed; the era name was changed.

literal: Day bingzi: Changsun Zhi pacified Tong Pass.
idiomatic: On bingzi day Changsun Zhi pacified Tong Pass.

literal: Day dingchou: the townspeople of Yong Province, Hou Zhongde and others together attacked Baoyu; Baoyu took the Princess of Nanyang and her son and with a little more than a hundred horsemen crossed the Wei and fled; Yong Province was pacified.
idiomatic: On dingchou day the townspeople of Yong Province, Hou Zhongde and others together attacked Baoyu; Baoyu took the Princess of Nanyang and her son and with a little more than a hundred horsemen crossed the Wei and fled; Yong Province was pacified.

literal: Second month: Changsun Zhi was made General of Chariots and Cavalry, Opener of the Office, Bearer of the Triple Staff, Inspector of Yong Province, and also Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Western Route Mobile Office commander.
idiomatic: In the second month Changsun Zhi was made general of chariots and cavalry, opener of the office, bearer of the triple staff, inspector of Yong Province, and also right vice director of the Masters of Writing and western route mobile office commander.

literal: Bandits burned and plundered west of Gong county, east of the passes, and south of Gonglu Ravine.
idiomatic: Bandits burned and plundered west of Gong county, east of the passes, and south of Gonglu Ravine.

literal: An edict ordered General of the Martial Guard Li Shengui commander to suppress and pacify them.
idiomatic: An edict ordered Li Shengui, general of the martial guard, commander, to suppress and pacify them.

literal: Day guichou: the emperor died at Xianyang Hall; he was nineteen.
idiomatic: On guichou day the emperor died at Xianyang Hall; he was nineteen.

literal: Day jiayin: the prince ascended the throne and proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.
idiomatic: On jiayin day the prince ascended the throne and proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.

literal: The empress dowager's edict stated: "The imperial house has held the calendar and received the chart for nearly two hundred years; successive sage ancestors have borne the altars in peace.
idiomatic: The empress dowager's edict stated: "The imperial house has held the calendar and received the chart for nearly two hundred years; successive sage ancestors have borne the altars in peace.

literal: Gaozu by literary thought preceded Heaven; Shizong by martial power governed the age—arms and legs were all worthy, the head was reverent and grave.
idiomatic: Gaozu by literary thought preceded Heaven; Shizong by martial power governed the age—arms and legs were all worthy, the head was reverent and grave.

literal: When the late emperor held the throne, he was again broad and humane; in nurture he followed the constant ways, warm, bright, respectful, and obedient.
idiomatic: When the late emperor held the throne, he was again broad and humane; in nurture he followed the constant ways, warm, bright, respectful, and obedient.

literal: I, small and dim, personally face the ten thousand states; my knowledge falls short of Tushan; my virtue shames the mother of Wen.
idiomatic: I, small and dim, personally face the ten thousand states; my knowledge falls short of Tushan; my virtue shames the mother of Wen.

literal: Bandit calamities arose in succession and the four marches had many affairs.
idiomatic: Bandit calamities arose in succession and the four marches had many affairs.

literal: I truly hoped the dome would lower protection and many heirs like unicorn toes would flourish.
idiomatic: I truly hoped the dome would lower protection and many heirs like unicorn toes would flourish.

literal: When Lady Pan of the Flowery Palace became pregnant in the pepper palace, I hoped for an heir; yet the bear showed no sign and the great viper was revealed.
idiomatic: When Lady Pan of the Flowery Palace became pregnant in the pepper palace, I hoped for an heir; yet the bear showed no sign and the great viper was revealed.

literal: At the time, because the realm was not yet at peace, I falsely called it the imperial heir, wishing thereby to settle men's hearts and bind them to the apex.
idiomatic: At the time, because the realm was not yet at peace, I falsely called it the imperial heir, wishing thereby to settle men's hearts and bind them to the apex.

literal: Who could have thought that in a single morning bow and sword could not be followed—the way of the state declined mid-course and the great line was cut off.
idiomatic: Who could have thought that in a single morning bow and sword could not be followed—the way of the state declined mid-course and the great line was cut off.

literal: The late emperor's great-grandson, heir of the former Prince of Lintao Baohui, Zhao, by body descends from Gaozu; his heavenly countenance is outstanding; the late emperor in his daily life nourished and loved him especially, his righteousness equal to a son, his matter fitting the jade disk.
idiomatic: The late emperor's great-grandson, heir of the former Prince of Lintao Baohui, Zhao, by body descends from Gaozu; his heavenly countenance is outstanding; the late emperor in his daily life nourished and loved him especially, his righteousness equal to a son, his matter fitting the jade disk.
